scope.mode: Lean Local Mode interpreted as current local live path

runtimeRoles.AiDeckDoctrineProfile: Live input from own deck snapshot; used mainly by legacy planners, mulligan/discard and debug.
runtimeRoles.DeckDoctrine: Diagnostic/meta type in semantic-ai-core-meta.ts, not live selection.
runtimeRoles.TacticalGoalState: Diagnostic/meta type in semantic-ai-core-meta.ts, no live persistence.
runtimeRoles.SemanticDecisionScore: Diagnostic/meta score type, not the live Semantic Runtime score.
runtimeRoles.ActionSemanticCandidate: Read-only projection exists and is tested, but is not called by live chooseSemanticRuntimeAction.

runner.obtain_breaker_coverage.gap: No explicit plan target, no blocked-plan pivot, no return to original run target.

runner.contest_remote.gap: No persistent TacticalPlan; live path directly scores or excludes current run LegalAction.

runner.opportunistic_central_run.gap: No unified central plan with HQ/RD/Archives target selection and freshness memory.

runner.cash_out_credit_bank.gap: No plan deciding payout timing against active goals.

corp.create_score_window.gap: Goal family exists diagnostically; no live TacticalPlan lifecycle.

corp.rez_defense.gap: No strategic rez-defense PlanStep tied to score/defense plan.

implementationPlan.phase1: Introduce TacticalPlan and PlanStep model with lifecycle, blockers, required capabilities and side-safe debug.
implementationPlan.phase2: Map PlanStep to current LegalActions via ActionSemanticCandidate projection and explicit blocker statuses.

checks.command: corepack pnpm --filter @netgrid/ai exec vitest run src/semantic-ai-core-meta.test.ts src/action-semantic-candidate.test.ts
